ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels and 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally positioned contiguous white blobs on both lobes, bordered by a wide, continuous black band on the trailing edges and around the median notch. The white regions contain high-frequency dark pixel speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp, acute vertex; estimated internal angle between inner lobe boundaries is approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-frequency micro-serrations with irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire continuous linear boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-relief clusters with yellowish-brown pixel coloration localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; dark circular pixel clusters (spots) are distributed across the light-intensity mid-lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of biological encrustation (likely barnacles) on the outer edges of both fluke tips, displaying distinct topographical relief and yellow-brown pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pattern of dark pixel mottling within the white regions, specifically a higher density of dark spots on the lower quadrant of the left lobe compared to the right.
